discovery: Switching sets and relabellings were discovered by exploratory exact search on known counterexamples before this contract. This is not a prospective hypothesis test or external preregistration.
primary: Explain both minimal H7 collision pairs with explicit regular orthogonal similarity, then prove connected ordinal-prefix lifts for every k>=1.

conventions.C: Full strict transitive 0/1 relation; not Hasse links
conventions.Q: Q_X=J_4/2-I_4, identity off X; Q^T Q=I and Q 1=1
conventions.connected: Connected undirected comparability graph, not strong connectivity of the directed acyclic graph

checks: Bind six original matrices to published source hashes
Verify both rational similarity certificates with integer identities
Independently compare all characteristic polynomials using determinants, not producer recurrence
Check isomorphism invariants and brute-force small-pair bijections
Check k=1,2,5 lifts as finite implementation checks of a general proved construction
Keep known connected n=8 D collision as a control against universal recovery claims
Reject altered switching matrix, relabelling, relation, polynomial and transitivity data
excluded: Universal recovery by D, isolated counts, or any proposed scalar
